products.name: Enterprise App Catalog Deployment in Microsoft Intune — Prepackaged Win32 Apps & Auto-Update — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy common Windows apps from Microsoft's curated Enterprise App Catalog instead of hand-packaging every installer — with built-in update management so catalog apps stay current automatically.
products.description:
Deploy common Windows apps from Microsoft's curated Enterprise App Catalog instead of hand-packaging every installer — with built-in update management so catalog apps stay current automatically.

Packaging every Win32 app by hand — wrapping the installer, writing detection rules, chasing each new version — is slow and never-ending. The Enterprise App Catalog gives Intune a Microsoft-curated set of prepackaged Windows apps with install logic and detection already built, plus update management so deployed catalog apps stay current without re-wrapping. This solution deploys apps from the Enterprise App Catalog end to end: selecting catalog apps, configuring install behavior and assignments, enabling update management, and running a pilot-first rollout — cross-referencing (not duplicating) the winget/Store-app lane and the app-deployment-troubleshooting product for break/fix.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • What the Enterprise App Catalog is — curated prepackaged Win32 apps with built-in install/detection, and where it fits vs hand-packaged Win32 and winget/Store apps (flagged verify-with-Microsoft)
  • Deploy a catalog app — select, configure install behavior/assignments, and validate detection without authoring your own rules
  • Update management — enable and govern automatic updates for catalog apps so they stay current without re-packaging
  • Pilot-first rollout — assign to a pilot ring, validate install + update, then wave to production; name every object
  • Operate — reporting on catalog-app install/update status, and when to prefer catalog vs winget vs custom Win32 (pointer to the winget/Store product)

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A working Enterprise App Catalog deployment that gets common Windows apps installed and kept current from a curated source — without hand-packaging every installer or chasing every version.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTAPPCAT-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Enterprise App Catalog apps, assignments, and update settings
    • ENTAPPCAT-Report.ps1 — export catalog-app install + update status to CSV
    • ENTAPPCAT-Set-Assignment.ps1 — assign a catalog app to a pilot group (the only state-changer)
    • ENTAPPCAT-Test-Install.ps1 — on-device check of IME health and a catalog app's install/detection state
    • ENTAPPCAT-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL that a pilot catalog app is deployed, assigned, detected, and updating

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
